text:
Predicates:
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Premises:
∃x (Place(x) ∧ Name(x, "Barutin Cove") ∧ LocatedIn(x, SouthShettlandIslands)) ::: Barutin Cove is in the South Shetland Islands.
∃x (Place(x) ∧ Name(x, "Snow Island") ∧ LocatedIn(x, SouthShettlandIslands)) ::: Snow Island is in the South Shetland Islands.
∃x (Place(x) ∧ Name(x, "Greenwich Island") ∧ LocatedIn(x, SouthShettlandIslands)) ::: Greenwich Island is in the South Shetland Islands.
∃x (Place(x) ∧ Name(x, "Deception Island") ∧ LocatedIn(x, SouthShettlandIslands)) ::: Deception Island is in the South Shetland Islands.
∃x (Place(x) ∧ Name(x, "Antarctica") ∧ LocatedIn(x, SouthShettlandIslands)) ::: Antarctica is in the South Shetland Islands.
Premises:
∀x ∀y ∀z ((LocatedIn(x, y) ∧ LocatedIn(y, z)) → LocatedIn(x, z)) ::: If place A is in place B and place B is in place C, then place A is in place C.
Conclusion:
¬LocatedIn(barutinCove, Antarctica) ::: Barutin Cove is not located in Antarctica.
